blurb: Guests experience hot air balloon flights over the scenic Cairns region and Atherton Tablelands, with options for shared or private flights. Some packages include door-to-door transfers, gourmet breakfasts, and reef tours with snorkeling and semi-submersible coral viewing. Flights offer views of local wildlife and landscapes, with professional photo packages and celebratory drinks included.
